title: Job control command v1
description: POST /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/control body (staff only). One operator action on the exact job and state the operator saw. 'cancel' requests cancellation (it is NOT a stop: the job completes as cancelled only after exact execution termination evidence). 'retry' creates a NEW job and output prefix once termination is proven; requestId becomes that new job's ID, so a replay after a lost response returns the same job. 'reconcile' re-evaluates the job from authoritative facts and never resubmits or starts anything. jobId must match the route; a request for a job that is no longer the recording's current job, or whose state differs from expectedState, is refused without mutation. Customers and collectors have no job-control route.
